title: Unit Event — That day, the Sky was Far Away — Episode3 I Chose Solitude

meta.Event: That day, the Sky was Far Away
meta.Event Outline: Shiho feels a great sense of fulfillment after Leo/need successfully reaches its ticket quota and performs in perfect sync for the audience. She recalls the time she spent on her own back in junior high.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line:
Okay!
Oh, wait... Should we invite Hinomori?

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line:
No, don't bother.
You never know when she's gonna snap.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line: True. I remember telling her a little joke about some other girls this one time and she told me not to talk about them behind their backs.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally.
You're talking about Mochizuki and Hoshino, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I wouldn't have lunch with any of you even if you asked...

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmates
rows.Line: What was that?! Who does she think she is...?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Just being in that classroom makes my nerves fray...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (People who don't conform are considered outsiders and tossed aside...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I know I can handle those kinds of situations better, but it's just...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate A
rows.Line: What's the name of that girl who always comes to talk to Hinomori? Hoshino or something? How's she able to put up with Hinomori like that?

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate B
rows.Line: No idea. However, I heard that they've known each other since they were little... They're alike in a way, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, I think I know what you're talking about. They're both pretty blunt and don't care about what happens around them.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Classmate B
rows.Line:
And they think they're so cool too.
It's like they believe they're too good for any of us...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(No, I can't just ignore them...
They have no right talking about Ichika or anyone else like that...)

rows.Speaker: Junior
rows.Line:
Yes...
There's something that I've been meaning to ask you, Mochizuki. Are you free right now?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, I am.
Why don't we have lunch together down by the courtyard while we talk?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Another girl from the brass band's asking her for advice. I guess it makes sense. Honami's nice and really reliable...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ichika told me that you've been acting strange lately. Did something happen? You can always ask me if there's anything that's bothering you...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
There's something I need to do...
Bye...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(But this is how things need to be...
This way, Honami and Ichika won't have to...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why did you tell me to leave you alone the other day?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You haven't been reading my messages either. Have you been talking to Saki at all?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You know exactly what I meant by what I said...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I don't have time to hang out with you or anyone else anymore.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
What are you talking about...?
Can't you just explain what's going on?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: There's nothing to explain, so quit following me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you do keep doing this, we'll never talk again...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(This is fine...
This is how things need to be...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Ichika and Honami are both incredibly nice people. So nice that they don't care how cold I am towards them...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (But that's also why I don't want to cause them any trouble...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't want either of them to suffer because of what I do.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (She'll be fine as long as she has them.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Saki will smile as long as those two are smiling alongside her...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I should be practicing playing my bass instead...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (The more time I have to myself, the more time I can spend practicing and playing.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I have to practice as much as humanly possible if I really am going to become a professional bassist...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It feels so muggy on the rooftop now.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I wish I could practice in an open classroom, but that's not gonna happen anytime soon.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I guess I'll just have to move to the shade.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Okay, one more time.
This song's pretty hard, but I should be able to play it if I take it one step at a time.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
(Good...
Just keep it up through the end and...)
